about: Build step 5.3 stage A1-1 (B1, the Goodhart gate): EVERY GRADED check of the step-5 graders (rate_step5.py R5.*, live_step5.py L5.*) that still reads an AI input, declared honestly for the code as it stands. `grader_checks.py` refuses to construct a GRADED check that reads the AI unless its id is here, and refuses an entry here that is not such a check (both ways exact).
